title: OPTDRV-005: The Raspberry Pi driver copies unbounded external strings into fixed buffers: `LIBCAMERA_LOG_LEVELS` into `previousSDKLogLevel[64]`, and libcamera camera names into `name
summary: OPTDRV-005: The Raspberry Pi driver copies unbounded external strings into fixed buffers: `LIBCAMERA_LOG_LEVELS` into `previousSDKLogLevel[64]`, and libcamera camera names into `name[128]` via `strcat()`. Long environment values or camera names can overflow stack/static buffers. Use bounded copies or `std::string` construction followed by `snprintf()` into INDIGO name buffers. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
